name: cTSEffectsManager::cTSEffectsManager
notes: Lane IT. Standalone shape (src/ts/cTSEffectsManager.h: our class derives from cITSEffectsManager +0, cIGZMessageTarget2 +4, cTSEffectsCollection +8; 0xc2c bytes, every member offset static_asserted). Hooked through the Construct adapter; the factory 0xbc86f0 (the only creation path) is hooked too, so every manager carries our vtables. EffectsManager_Operations builds each side from the same garbage-filled block (mode 0 the original constructor, 1 ours, 2 the adapter) and compares the whole object (every container with buckets and capacities, every scalar, the random generator's state). The callback timer member (0x9ccf32 / 0x9ccfa9, ours since lane LR: cRZCallbackTimer::Construct / Destruct, stood in on both sides) and the cheat registrations 0xbc5aa0 / 0xbdb700 (not ours yet) are stood in by the test. Every slot is ours since lane XG (Init, Shutdown, LoadEffects, CreateEffect, CreateVisualEffect, Update, ListActive, ListEffects, DoMessage); slot 1 and the +8 AddRef 0xbc5d10 are the folded shared_vf_207d70, left unhooked and unreplaced (a body shared with other class families). Mutants build/it_mut_mgr.log (55 over the class: 53 killed; the 2 survivors, Release at a count of 2 and Reload's reloading flag, killed in build/it_mut_mgr2.log after the tests were strengthened).
